name: Quiet Meadow Farm
description: A rustic farm venue on 130 acres beneath the mountains in Mapleton, with a large barn with a fireplace, outdoor ceremony and reception space, a bridal suite and groom's room, a prep kitchen, and an included day-of coordinator.
seatedText: No seated capacity stated; max 300 guests (225 in winter)

Features > Cleanup crew.wording: Full setup, takedown and cleanup by staff

Other > Cake table.wording: Extra tables for cake, gifts, or sign-in areas

items.label: Description
items.value: A rustic farm venue on 130 acres beneath the mountains in Mapleton, with a large barn with a fireplace, outdoor ceremony and reception space, a bridal suite and groom's room, a prep kitchen, and an included day-of coordinator.

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Peak season Apr-Oct 2026: Fri or Sat 2pm-10pm — $6,600
Peak season Apr-Oct 2026: Mon-Thu 2pm-10pm — $5,600
Winter Nov 2026-Mar 2027: Fri or Sat 2pm-10pm — $5,800
Winter Nov 2026-Mar 2027: Mon-Thu 2pm-10pm — $5,200
Mornings Mon-Sat 8am-12:30pm: peak 2026 — $3,300; winter 2026-27 — $3,200
Reception only, Mon-Thu 4:30pm-10pm — $4,400
Peak season Apr-Oct 2027: Fri or Sat — $6,800; Thu — $6,400; Mon-Wed — $5,800
Winter Nov 2027-Mar 2028: Fri or Sat — $6,000; Thu — $5,600; Mon-Wed — $5,000
Mornings 2027: peak — $3,400; winter 2027-28 — $3,200
All-day rental 10am-10pm — $2,000 more than the 2pm-10pm rate
Every rental includes the standard inclusions: farmhouse tables, chairs, decorating package, setup/takedown/cleanup, bridal suite, groom's room, prep kitchen, day-of coordinator

items.label: Deposit
items.value: Deposit and signed contract required to reserve

items.label: Seated
items.value: No seated capacity stated; max 300 guests (225 in winter)

items.label: Cleanup crew
items.value: Full setup, takedown and cleanup by staff

items.label: Included items
items.value:
15 farmhouse tables
4 barrel-top tables (two 6 ft, two 8 ft)
16-foot barn-wood buffet table
150 chairs
White, ivory or tan table runners
Decorating package: centerpieces, lanterns, candles, greenery, rustic décor
Extra tables for cake, gifts and sign-in
Cake stands
Sweetheart table
Easels and reserved signs
Drink troughs
HDMI-ready TV
Barn fireplace

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value:
Included
Setup, takedown and cleanup handled by venue staff

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Limited: speaker system for soft background music only (no mic provided)
DJ from the venue's preferred list required

items.label: For rent
items.value: Plates, flatware, stemware and extra rentals arranged through the venue office (prices not listed)

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Day-of coordinator included
Additional event staff on site
Lawn games available (must be pre-approved)

items.label: Items
items.value: Small log card holders (60); Wood reserved signs (14); Paper reserved signs (15); Drink troughs (4); Copper lanterns (15); Small votives (50); Medium votives (25); Large white lanterns (6); Wheat centerpieces (23); Brown lanterns (15); Large crates (5); Milk jars for ceremony (9); Sweetheart table; Log cake stand; Cake stand; Easels (20); Bud vases (36); Assorted artificial flowers; Flower girl baskets (10)

items.label: Cake table
items.value: Extra tables for cake, gifts, or sign-in areas

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Caterer must be from the venue's approved list
Homemade food not allowed; all food must be commercially prepared
Venue staff do not serve, bus or clear food

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Prep kitchen for caterers
Refrigerator
Freezer
Microwave
Warming oven

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
Alcohol allowed
$300 alcohol fee (includes a bar and additional staff)
Bartender from the preferred list required
Bar open 4 hours maximum

items.label: Required
items.value: Caterers: El Camino Kitchen; Bro Bro's Frozen Treats; Brown Brothers; Greenhollow Catering; Fiore Pizza; Beehive Catering; Lux Catering; Landmark Catering; Penguin Brothers; Pinguino's Gelato; Marvellous Catering Co.; R&R BBQ; Culinary Crafts; J. Dawgs; Magleby's; The Place Pizza; Thirst Drinks and Catering · Bartenders: Copa Bar Service; Cheers and Swizzles · Djs: DJ JC; Alive Entertainment; DJ Cooper Brown; DJ Chase Worthen

items.label: Sparklers
items.value:
No
Sparklers and cold sparkler machines are not allowed

items.label: Times
items.value:
Mon-Sat 2pm-10pm (evening)
Mon-Sat 10am-10pm (all-day, extra $2,000)
Mon-Sat 8am-12:30pm (morning)
Mon-Thu 4:30pm-10pm (reception only)
Closed Sundays

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Caterer, DJ and bartender must be from the preferred lists
No live bands
No sparklers, cold sparkler machines, confetti, glitter, rice, bird seed or flower petals (petals allowed during the ceremony)
No bounce houses, mechanical bulls or carnival rides
Lawn games must be pre-approved
No pets without prior approval (service animals and ceremony animals excepted)
No food or décor drop-off before the scheduled time
No rehearsals on site
Maximum 89 decibels (noise ordinance)
Own sound equipment limited to a small boombox-style system
No smoking except in the designated area
No full-size buses

items.label: Notes
items.value:
130-acre property
Maximum capacity 300 guests (225 in winter season)
Closed Sundays
All event item rentals go through the venue office
